event_chain.summary: Precision bug in Compound V2 fork exploited

summary: On September 26, 2024 an attacker exploited a precision bug in OnyxDAO's forked Compound V2 code, using a nearly empty market to manipulate exchange rates and drain about $3.2-3.8 million in VUSD, XCN, DAI, WBTC and USDT. PeckShield flagged the attack.
